entities.name: Jitka Wothis
entities.description: A minotaur, wife of Grimbly Wothis.

entities.name: Kodolaag
entities.description: Works with Olrich to free Zita.

entities.name: Olrich
entities.description: Companion of Kodolaag, disguised as a child.

events.summary: Merret sneaks into Grimbly's kitchen, tries an Elixir of Focus, and turns invisible as Jitka enters.
events.quote: Merret became invisible to Jitka, who was close to touching them but remained unaware of his presence

events.summary: Lucinka gives Kodolaag and Olrich a box of items for a mission to free Zita.
events.quote: a mission to free Zita from prison

events.summary: At Udzec they line up behind Jitka; Olrich wears a romper and swallows the amulet.
events.quote: Kodolaag convinced Olrich to wear the romper and swallow the amulet

events.summary: Kodolaag plants a whiskey bottle in Jitka's hood to distract the nullmages.
events.quote: Kodolaag then placed the whiskey bottle in Jitka's hood

events.summary: Jitka recognizes them and alerts the mages; they are bound and shipped to a new prison.
events.quote: Jitka recognized them and alerted the mages

relations.quote: Jitka Wothis is a minotaur and wife of Grimbly Wothis
allowing Kodolaag and Olrich to pass through the inspection
